svg.title: Orbiter 8 intro, zoom: the room: where you play

g.text: Power’s on. So are the bills. The terminal
on the desk has your account.

svg.text: 23:41 · Curfew: violence high, security response limited · Block 7 · Unit 7-2216

floors below, the floors above as a ghost,
